videos.title: כך מייצרים אופנועי Harley-Davidson — סיור במפעל יורק
videos.content: See how Harley-Davidson motorcycles are made at York Vehicle Operations in Pennsylvania. This 15-minute factory documentary follows the manufacturing process from frame welding and painted-component production to engine assembly, motorcycle final assembly, functional testing and final quality inspection. The video shows both automated and manual production processes, including robotic frame welding, fuel tank fabrication and leak testing, fender forming, paint finishing, powder coating of engine housings, automated handling of cylinder heads and crankcases, V-twin engine assembly and final motorcycle testing. You will also see the assembly of the liquid-cooled Revolution Max 1250 engine, followed by production and inspection of Harley-Davidson Pan America motorcycles. These pointers will allow you to quickly assess if a vehicle is even worth pursuing before asking the seller for the paperwork, taking the vehicle on a test drive, or even performing a thorough mechanical inspection on it. Start by walking around the vehicle by taking a look for any obvious signs of damage, dents, rust or accident repair. Next, examine the interior of the vehicle and take note of its general condition - any smells, stains, cleanliness. Generally a vehicle that was kept in good condition would have been properly maintained under the hood. Secondly, pay attention to the tires and brakes. videos.title: BMW M2 עם 1,100 כ״ס מול Lamborghini Huracán Performante — מרוץ דראג
videos.content: Does a RWD Red Bull drift car have what it takes to beat an AWD Lambo in a straight line?! It’s time for a drag race with one of the craziest M2s we’ve ever seen! We’ve got our hands on a Red Bull BMW M2 - and it’s been converted into a drift car! So we’re going to see if a car that’s made for cornering at extreme speed has what it takes to beat a Lamborghini in a straight line! Does it stand a chance? Let’s take a closer look at the stats… The Red Bull M2 is powered by a BMW S58 engine. However, rather than having twin turbos, this 3-litre straight-six instead comes with one single (yet massive!) turbo, and the power output has been increased to an incredible 1,100hp and 1,200Nm! All of this power is sent to the rear wheels only via a 5-speed sequential gearbox, and being a drift car, it’s super light, tipping the scales at around 1,400kg. As for the Lambo, it’s the Huracan Performante!

videos.content: פלקסווגן ג'טה במבחן דרכים של כתבי אוטו. למידע חשוב לגבי מפרטים והשוואות רכב לחצו על הלינק פלקסווגן ג'טה - חוות דעת, מבחני דרכים, צריכת דלק, התנהגות כביש, נוחות נסיעה, מחיר, ביצועים, אבזור, אביזרים ועוד. אהבתם את הסרטון? עשו לנו לייק ושתפו עם חברים! לא אהבתם? ספרו לנו בתגובות מה הפריע לכם כדי שנוכל להשתפר בעתיד. מגיש: דני פרומצ'נקו לייעוץ אובייקטיבי בחינם לפני קניה של כל סוגי הרכב היכנסו לאתר להרשמה לערוץ "אוטו TV" וסרטונים נוספים לחצו כאן לכל חדשות הרכב, מבחני רכב וחוות דעת אובייקטיביות, מידע וכלים שימושיים לקוני רכב, תערוכות רכב בישראל ובעולם - המגזין הגדול והוותיק בישראל – היכנסו עכשיו - למבחני דרכים נוספים צפו - מבחן דרכים למשפחתית הקומפקטית של פולקסווגן, הפולקסווגן ג'טה

This factory tour follows the main stages of Toyota vehicle production: the press shop, pre-welding operations, welding shop, paint shop, assembly shop, Toyota bZ4X assembly operations, quality checks and final logistics at the port. videos.content: Did your steering suddenly get more squishy, or pulling hard to one side, or shaky? You might have a flat tire! In this video, Len shows you why you should pull over as soon as its safe, and address your flat tire, instead of continuing to drive on it! Driving on a flat tire can be dangerous for you, other drivers, and your vehicle! A vehicle with a flat tire can be difficult to control, and may spin or go off the road! It can cause more damage to a tire that could otherwise be repairable, and you can damage wheels or rims, and other parts of your car or truck too! So, don't drive on that flat! videos.title: תכנות שלט ללא מפתח בטויוטה
videos.content: Programming a keyless remote transmitter on a Toyota / Lexus vehicle with factory installed keyless entry and alarm. This procedure should work on Toyota's made in the late 90's to the early 2000's, such as the Toyota Solara, Camry, Tacoma, Tundra, Sequoia, Sienna, Highlander and Avalon. This procedure will not work on vehicles with a dealer installed remote, i.e. with a service button / LED on the driver side of the dash-board, such as those with the RS3000 / RS3200 system. Programming the remote involves cycling the locks and ignition. If the vehicle does not enter programming mode or the locks fail to cycle, it could be a worn lock actuator. Try cycling the locks manually instead of using the power lock button switch on the door. videos.title: ה-BX התקלקלה, אבל לא מהסיבה שאתם חושבים
videos.content: הם אמרו לי לפחד מהמערכת ההידראולית. הם אמרו שבסוף אהפוך לסטטיסטיקה של סיטרואן קלאסית. הם צדקו... בערך. בסרטון של היום, יצאתי לעשות נסיעת סקירה של 4 שנות בעלות על סיטרואן BX GTI 1989. במקום זה, הפכתי לחלק מהנרטיב של "סיטרואן לא אמינה". סה"כ 500 מטר מהבית שלי, איבדתי הגה כוח, איבדתי את המתלים ההידרופנאומטיים, והייתי תקוע על המדרכה. פאניקה. האם זה האסון ההידראולי הגדול שכולם הזהירו אותי מפניו? נזילת LHM ענקית? האמת פשוטה בהרבה. רצועת האביזרים (accessory belt) שלי נקרעה. זה תיקון של 35 שקל, אבל הוא שיתק לחלוטין את הרכב. אני אקח אתכם דרך הדרמה כולה, מרגע ההפתעה, דרך השגת הרצועה החדשה, ועד לתהליך התיקון העצמאי בחניה רנדומלית. מה למדנו? פחד הוא דבר חזק, וסיטרואן הידראולית זוכה לשם רע. אבל לפעמים, זו פשוט רצועה פשוטה שיכולה להקרע בכל רכב. מצטרפים כתומכים לערוץ ומקבלים גישה לסרטונים לפני כולם: עץ הקישורים וחנות לרכישת מוצרים: כל עבודה שנעשית על פי הסרטון הינה באחריות הצופה בלבד. Most people do not know what is knock sensor but it is very important to ensure that your car runs at its best. Never drive with bad knock sensor especially do not drive with bad knock sensor for long time because it can cause expensive damage to the engine and the exhaust system. Most small engine car will have 1 knock sensor if you have a v6 or v8 engine you most likely will have 2 knock sensors. In addition some straight six cylinder engine will use 2 knock sensor system as well. 保时捷911 GT2 RS MR设置Nürburgring Lap Record
videos.content: Porsche has set another new record on the Nürburgring-Nordschleife in cooperation with Manthey-Racing. On Thursday, 25 October 2018, the Porsche GT2 RS MR with 515 kW (700 hp) completed a lap of the 20.6-kilometre long circuit in 6:40.3 minutes. No other road-legal vehicle has ever been so fast on ‘The Green Hell’ track. Lars Kern was at the wheel of the sports car, which had been especially set up for the ‘Nordschleife’ by Porsche engineers and Manthey-Racing experts. The Porsche test driver already set a lap record in September 2017 in a series-production Porsche 911 GT2 RS*. “We kept our eye on the weather all day and thought hard about whether such a drive was possible. We would not have taken any risks if it was raining or if the track was slightly damp,” says Dr. Frank-Steffen Walliser, Head of Motorsport and GT Cars. The Porsche 911 GT2 RS was equipped with the new performance kit

We found the Hyundai crossways on the road, and quite stuck. Luckily, no fluids were leaking and all the tires still held air, so we were able to get it turned around and headed back up. The trip up was slow and painful. There were no amount of rocks we could roll out of the way to make this vehicle travel smoothly up this road. Sometimes we move rocks out of the way, and sometimes we moved rocks in front of the tires to build a makeshift ramp to get it up to the next level. videos.title: שיפוץ דיפרנציאל Positraction בשברולט ביסקיין 1963 — חלק 1: פירוק
videos.content: Weber State University (WSU) - Automotive Technology Department - Transmission Lab. We take on a fun and unusual project, the overhaul and restoration of the rear differential of a 1963 Chevrolet Biscayne. This 8.2" type 3 differential was used by General Motors from 1955-1964. The differential design utilizes threaded adjustable side bearing spacers to control side bearing preload and backlash. This video is part one of a four-part series on the overhaul and restoration process. Part one includes the disassembly and inspection of differential assembly. Part two includes the positraction differential case setup and overhaul, Part three includes differential case problems found. videos.content: סרטון פתיחת קופסא וסקירה לגרניק נטען מדגם Worx Hydroshot WG629E.1. אני גר ברב קומות, ואין לי חנייה פרטית. לכן, עד היום כשרציתי לשטוף את הרכב, הייתי צריך לעבוד קשה בשיטת "2 הדליים"- דלי אחד לסבון, דלי אחד למים נקיים, ולשטוף את הסבון בזריזות מכל מקטע שסיבנתי כי בשמש בארץ הסבון מתייבש מהר ומשאיר משקע לבן על גבי הרכב. נתקלתי בגרניק הנטען הזה, ומייד התאהבתי ברעיון- להוריד את הסבון בקלות מהרכב, ולחסוך זמן בשטיפה? נשמע מצויין! אז החלטתי לעשות על זה סרטון של "פתיחת קופסא" והדגמה קצרה למה המכשיר יכול לעשות לבדו (בלי סבון בסרטון ההדגמה). וכמובן, איך אפשר בלי טיפ או שניים? :-) הכלי נרכש בכספי שלי, לא קיבלתי אותו עבור הדגמה או יצירת סרטון עליו. מה שאתם רואים בסרטון זו דעתי הכנה על המכשיר.

videos.content: Do you already know the "apple trick"? - Here I show it to you and explain what it brings the windshield with an apple rub! You've probably never thought of rubbing the windshield of your car with an apple, right? But this is a really good idea and even a very old trick that is especially popular among truck drivers. Rubbing the windshield with an apple has two advantages. Firstly, you can remove insects from the windshield with a cut apple. Since these can be dissolved by the fruit acid very easily. And you have a much better view if the windshield wiper fails. The malic acid creates a lotus effect on your windshield. The water simply rolls off and does not stick to the windshield. This means that you can continue driving for a while without wipers, despite the rain, and still have sufficient visibility. videos.title: כיצד לשפץ קליפר בלם קדמי עם EricTheCarGuy
tags: how to remove a caliper piston
how does a brake caliper work
videos.content: In the past few videos I've been getting my Fairmont ready to take to the drag strip. Since I discovered some brake issues I thought it best to address those. In this video I rebuild the right front caliper. Turns out after I replaced the brake hoses that it was sticking and not releasing. Not wanting to spend the money on a new caliper, I decided to go for a rebuild. Now may of you may question the logic of doing this, especially when you see the caliper piston, but keep in mind my intention is to replace the entire brake system when I upgrade the engine and suspension on this car so it doesn't make sense to make a huge investment in this car as it is now. So for the naysayers, it's temporary, chill out. Either way I hope you enjoy this video and that it helps you if you find yourself needing to rebuild a front brake caliper. It is a cheap alternative IF your piston isn't all corroded.

videos.content: In today's video, we will show you how to make a hydraulic kit that will be used in the video where we will build an electric vehicle to transport various loads. Link above. In order for the starter to be used as a motor, I had to lock the axle in one place so that it would not slide out. Then I made a mounting from the sleeve so that the starter could drive the pump. When both elements were joined together, I started working on the hydraulic oil tank. I used a large square tube and flat bars for this, which saved a lot of work. The next step was to connect all the hydraulics and conduct a test. In the video we showed how much force this set has when crushing various things, but in fact, it will be used to lift the loading box in an electric vehicle.

videos.content: מקסוס מיפה 7 – המיניוואן החשמלי שמגדיר מחדש את הקטגוריה? הכירו את מקסוס מיפה 7, המיניוואן החשמלי שמביא חוויית נהיגה חדשנית ומתקדמת. דני דרייב, כתב הרכב הטכנולוגי, סוקר את כל מה שחשוב לדעת: ✅ עיצוב חיצוני – קווים מודרניים, חזית עתידנית ותשומת לב לפרטים. ✅ תא נוסעים – מרווח, מאובזר ומלא בטכנולוגיה מתקדמת. ✅ נוחות – האם הוא באמת מספק נסיעה שקטה ונעימה? ✅ מנוע וביצועים – הנעה חשמלית עוצמתית וטווח נסיעה מרשים. בסוף הסקירה נשאלת השאלה: האם זה הרכב שמגדיר מחדש את קטגוריית המיניוואנים החשמליים? 📢 אל תשכחו להירשם לערוץ ספידומטר כדי לקבל עוד סקירות, מבחני דרך ותוכן רכב מענין ! 00:00-00:33 פתיח 00:33-01:24 עיצוב חיצוני 01:24-02:19 תא נוסעים 02:19-02:48 מנוע וביצועים 02:48-03:20 נוחות נסיעה 03:20-04:12 אבזור בטיחות 04:12-04:29 תא מטען 04:29-04:41 מחיר 04:41-05:28 סיכום #מקסוסMIFA7 #רכבחשמלי #מיניוואןחשמלי #סקירתרכב #דנידרייב #חשמליבישראל #MaxusMIFA7 #סקירהרכב #רכבמשפחתי #רכבלמשפחה #מכוניותחדשות #רכב

videos.content: Here's how to FLUSH the power steering fluid from your car and REPLACE it with BRAND NEW fluid! This method will work on ANY vehicle with hydraulic power steering, and is SAFE, EASY, and CHEAP to do YOURSELF at home! Power steering fluid wears out over time and can lose its lubricating properties. While many service manuals may not give a specific time to change this fluid, many power steering rack failures can be attributed to dirty or contaminated fluid. Flushing the fluid is fairly straight forward. The car must be on jackstands with the front wheels in the air for the wheels to turn freely. You'll need a 3/8" clear vinyl hose, a barb fitting, a bucket, some power steering fluid and rags, that's all! Fred calls on the engineering assistance of his friend Frank and the Poly Goats Off Road Club to finish this big-block powered monster go cart. To test whether it stands up against the regular sized go-kart, they head out to the dirt for a head to head battle of wits, agility, and power. Tune in to see who comes out on top!

The quattro logo in a matt titanium-look is positioned in the lower section of the gloss black grill with its matt black Singleframe. The lateral air inlets, which have been enlarged once again, are each divided by vertical strips on the inside and outside. For cooling purposes there are additional radiators located behind the typical RS honeycomb grill. The lateral air inlets that extend almost all the way to the front wheel wells make the new TT RS appear extremely wide. A continuous front spoiler that is drawn up steeply at the lateral ends pulls the front apron down sharply, giving the car its distinctive, motorsport-inspired look. videos.title: עלתה כמו דירה, היום היא טוחנת סלעים: פורשה קאיין Safari Build
videos.content: ב-2008 הפורשה הזאת עלתה כמו דירה קטנה ויועדה לאוטובאן בגרמניה. היום? היא עומדת על צמיגי שטח מלא (MT), מוגבהת, עם פגושים חתוכים, וטוחנת סלעים. פגשתי את פיליפ ואת מפלצת ה"ספארי בילד" שלו (פורשה קאיין דור ראשון, מנוע V8 4.8 ליטר) ליום טכני ביער בן שמן. נכנסנו לקרביים של הבנייה כדי להבין: איך מתלים נפרדים (IFS/IRS) מתמודדים עם ההצלבות, האם האלקטרוניקה הגרמנית באמת מפצה על היעדר סרן חי, וכמה באמת כואב בכיס לשבור מכלול של פורשה בסלעים. לא חסכנו בשאלות קשות - החל מהכאב בכיס ועד המבטים שמקבלים מג'יפאים אחרים בתחתית המעלה. 👇 רוצים את המסלול שעשינו היום?

videos.title: Porsche 911 רסטומוד עם 1,000 כ״ס מול Lamborghini Revuelto — מרוץ דראג
videos.content: Can a carbon fibre 911 993 with over 1,000hp take down a Lambo? We’ve got our hands on the Gunther Werks F26, and we’re putting it up against some incredible supercars! The Gunther Werks F26 is based on a Porsche 993, and it’s powered by a 4-litre twin-turbo flat-six that delivers an incredible 1,067hp and 1,017Nm! This power is sent to the rear wheels only via a 6-speed manual, and its carbon-fibre body means it weighs just 1,347kg! It’s limited to just 26 units worldwide, so it costs £1,200,000! So, given we’ve got our hands on such a rare car, we wanted to put it up against some supercar royalty, starting with the Porsche 911 GT3 RS. The GT3 RS is equipped with a 4-litre NA flat-six, and this creates 525hp and 465Nm. Power is sent to the rear via a 7-speed dual-clutch, and it tips the scales at 1,450kg. Should the Gunther Werks defeat the GT3 RS, we’ll bring in a Huracán Performante.

videos.title: הוספת כניסת AUX למערכת שמע עם נגן תקליטורים
videos.content: Here's how to add an auxiliary input to your CD stereo on your car. This method is applicable to almost all vehicles that have an analog CD player. Demonstrated here is a Toyota Corolla. Adding an auxiliary input to your vehicle is a cheap and easy method to get CD quality audio to your car's sound system from your phone, tablet, bluetooth device or MP3 player. FM transmitters cause too much interference, static, and have poor sound quality. Aftermarket radios are more expensive, and have a tacky, flashy odd look that won't bode well with a vintage car. This method employs the use of the CD player lines in the radio. A blank CD is played, and sound input from a 3.5mm stereo extension cable is injected into the analog CD lines going from the radio to the equalizer. videos.title: כיצד מייצרים מלט במפעלים?
videos.content: A cement is a binder, a substance used for construction that sets, hardens, and adheres to other materials to bind them together. Cement is seldom used on its own, but rather to bind sand and gravel (aggregate) together. Cement mixed with fine aggregate produces mortar for masonry, or with sand and gravel, produces concrete. Concrete is the most widely used material in existence and is behind only water as the planet's most-consumed resource. Cement manufacturing is a complex process that begins with mining and then grinding raw materials that include limestone and clay, to a fine powder, called raw meal, which is then heated to a sintering temperature as high as 1450 °C in a cement kiln. In this process, the chemical bonds of the raw materials are broken down and then they are recombined into new compounds. videos.title: היכרות מעמיקה עם סוללת המתח הגבוה של Kia EV9
videos.content: Join me as I assemble a cell module from a Kia EV9 626-volt high-voltage battery. Learn which parts are involved and how they are connected. CLARIFICATION: I did not mean to imply that I could drive for 1 hour using 1 pouch cell; I was talking about the capacity of each cell and the entire battery, but I should have mentioned the voltage needed at that point in the video. My personal car has a 355.2-volt (nominal) battery and uses 60 amps at 70 mph, for a total of 21.3 kW per hour. I estimate the Kia EV9 with a 551.76-volt (nominal) battery uses about 38.6 amps at 70 mph, for 21.3 kW per hour. The Kia with a 98.985 kWh (nominal) 180 Ah battery should be able to drive about 4.6 hours at 70 mph, for a driving range of 322 miles. videos.title: בדיקת רכב לפי מספר
videos.content: בדיקת רכב לפני קנייה בעמוד זה תוכלו להזמין בדיקה מקיפה לרכב לפני הקנייה. השירות מספק מידע מקיף על הרכב: מספר בעלים קודמים, קיומם של מגבלות משפטיות, מפרט טכני, גרסה ורמת אבזור, מידע על מעבר מבחני רישוי (טסטים), וכן שימושים מסחריים (כגון מונית, רכב להשכרה, ליסינג או רכב חברה). למה זה חשוב: - עוזר להימנע מרכישת רכב עם בעיות נסתרות - מספק תמונה מלאה של האבזור והמצב הטכני - מראה האם הרכב שימש למטרות מסחריות - מגביר את הביטחון שלכם בהחלטת הקנייה הזינו את מספר הרכב – ותקבלו דוח מפורט תוך מספר דקות. קנייה בטוחה מתחילה בבדיקה!

videos.title: Ferrari Daytona SP3 מודל 2025 עם מנוע V12 ו־829 כ״ס — האחרונה מסוגה? | המוסך של ג׳יי לנו
videos.content: Jay gets behind the wheel of the achingly beautiful, naturally aspirated 2025 Ferrari Daytona SP3 — a retro-futuristic V12 masterpiece from Maranello. With only 599 units produced worldwide (and just ~35 with full carbon fiber exposed), this isn't just a car... it's a rolling time machine that reminds us what driving used to feel like before EVs and turbos took over. Collector David Lee brings his custom green Daytona SP3 — part of his “relish” collection — and the two take it for a joyride through LA traffic. From the 6.5L V12 pulled from the 812 Superfast to talk of manual gearboxes returning, this might be Jay’s favorite modern Ferrari yet. ✅ 829 horsepower ✅ 9500 RPM redline ✅ 7-speed dual clutch ✅ Naturally aspirated V12 ✅ Carbon fiber everything Stick around for Jay's take on why this is more fun than anything turbocharged or electric, and why sometimes, you just gotta feel it. videos.content: Do you know this trick with your car key? - Here I show you what you can do with it! If you have a car key with a wireless remote, then you should know this trick. Yet many people don't know this trick! Because you can use your car key to raise or lower your windows. How exactly this works, I show you in this video. For this you only have to hold the button to open or close for several seconds. If you want to lower the windows, it should be the open button and if you want to close them, the button to lock the doors. After 2-3 seconds the windows will start to open or close. This is especially useful if you forget to close a window. You only have to press the button and the window will close without you having to get into the car again to close the windows. Be sure to try it out next time. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

videos.title: כך נשמע מיסב גלגל פגום ברכב
tags: what wheel bearing noise sounds like
videos.content: WHAT WHEEL BEARING NOISE SOUNDS ON A CAR If you have a bad wheel bearing or want to know what bad wheel bearing noise sounds like in this video we will explain that. Bad wheel bearing noise is very distinctive and often by removing the tire you can feel if a wheel bearing is bad. Bad wheel bearing will be noise at higher speeds and it will sound like humming, grinding noise depending on how it fails and how worn the wheel bearing is. We demonstrated what wheel bearing noise sounds like while we where replacing this wheel bearing because many of you requested this information. Hopefully the video will be helpful to any of you that need to see what bad wheel bearing noise sounds like. This video will outline simple checks you can make on your car. The more frequent you check things like tire pressure and engine oil the better, but it's good to check all of the items in the video at the very least twice a year. We'll look at three main sections in this video. First we'll discuss tires, brakes, and suspension. Next we'll look under the hood and look at fluids and filters. videos.title: כמה כוח מפיקה BMW E60 M5 עם מנוע V10 וקילומטראז׳ גבוה?
videos.content: In this episode, we do a bit of work on project X5, 2008 E70 4.8i, and project Raleigh, 2007 E60 M5 with a 6-speed manual. The X5 gets a new A/C compressor & condenser, and front wheel bearings. The E60 M5 gets a fresh oil change, new starter, brake fluid and clutch line flush, purge valves, new blower fan and resistor, and soft-touch plastic removal. Then we go for a nice drive and end up on a dyno to see how much power the 5.0L S85 V10 engine with 246k km (153k miles) makes! Also, the dojo gets another Bendpak 2-post lift!

videos.title: היכן נמצא חיישן החמצן הראשון בגדה 1 של המנוע?
videos.content: WHERE IS O2 SENSOR BANK 1 SENSOR 1 ON A CAR, OXYGEN SENSOR If you have a car and you need to replace oxygen sensor bank 1 sensor 1 / upstream oxygen sensor in this video we will explain where oxygen sensor bank 1 sensor 1 / upstream oxygen sensor is located on a 3 or 4 cylinder engine. Most 3 and 4 cylinder engine have 2 oxygen sensors. The first oxygen sensor is known as upstream oxygen sensor and the second oxygen sensor is known as downstream oxygen sensor. You will need to know where oxygen sensor bank 1 sensor 1 is located so you do no replace the wrong oxygen sensor. Hopefully the vidoe will be helpful and you will be able to see where your oxygen sensor bank 1 sensor 1 is located on your car. videos.title: ממכונית לטנדר בשבע דקות — תיעוד מואץ מלא של BMW E36
tags: From a Car to a Truck
Grind Hard Plumbing Co | גרינד הארד
videos.content: This is the full raw time lapse of the BMW build. We started with the 1998 BMW E36 coupe, towed it home and got to work. The condition of the car when we started was rough and it had five different colors of body panels, front end damage and no cultch. But the old E36 did start so we knew there was greatness to come. We decided to build this BMW up for The Gambler 500 and we wanted it to be special so we chopped the E36 in half and supported the weak points with a roll cage. We welded the differential for better drifts, punt in a new clutch then cut the body more for our wide body flares. Next we borrowed some 18” wheels and bought some amazon 2” wheel spacers, painted the doors yellow and took it to the Oregon Gambler 500. It survived! Since then we straight piped the ute, added some tractor flaps and rallied the heck out of the thing. Fan email grindhardplumbingcoATgmail.com From a Car

videos.content: This is the new 2020 718 Cayman GT4 and its joined by its slightly cheaper convertible twin, the 2020 Porsche Boxster Spyder. Both are a dream enthusiast formula. They are the Cayman and Boxster in their ultimate forms (until perhaps a GT4RS arrives), and what better way to test them than to hit some of our favourite back roads? Specced today at $148,000 CAD (GT4) and $129,000 CAD (Boxster Spyder), they command a hefty premium, so are they worth it? James and Thomas jump behind the wheel of both to experience them and discuss them inside and out. Watch and enjoy! The next generation of flat-six turbocharged engines has been further developed and is more powerful than ever before, with 331 kW (450 PS) in the S models. Many people always ask me: "Can I driver with bad knock sensor because it is too expensive to replace it". In this video we will explain how a bad knock sensor can cause more damage to the engine if you keep driving with bad knock sensor and how it can affect your car. Knock sensor is very important for the normal operation of your engine. videos.content: Deep in the Arizona desert lies a history most people have completely forgotten. In this episode of Recon America, we’re tracking 115 miles of dirt to uncover the ruins of a "Vanished Empire" and the remnants of a Top Secret WWII military base where a weapon known only as "The Gizmo" was born. From the preserved foundations of the Swansea Townsite to the haunting silence of the 150th Station Hospital at Camp Bouse, this journey was a reminder of the grit and secrecy that shaped the American West. I’m pushing the Land Cruiser and the Patriot Campers ST5 to the limit on this one. You’ll see the reality of overlanding—including some unexpected rear sag and the real-world fix that saved the trip. videos.content: In 1879, more than 250 pioneers were asked to do something close to impossible: leave everything behind and build a wagon road through a thousand-mile cliff. They said yes. Nearly 150 years later, I took the Jeep and trailer down the Hole in the Rock trail outside Escalante, Utah, to retrace part of that route myself. What starts as graded gravel turns into washboard, slickrock, and shelf roads the deeper you go and that was the easy version. The pioneers had no road at all. They built it as they went, and a journey they figured for six weeks ended up taking six months. Along the way I stopped at Devil's Garden, the natural amphitheater at Dance Hall Rock, camped under some of the quietest, darkest skies I've ever seen, and paid my respects at a memorial that's a sober reminder this country still demands it. videos.title: אל תמהרו לשנוא — תיבות eCVT הן פתרון הנדסי מבריק
videos.content: How does an eCVT work? No belts, no pulleys, so simple! With a single planetary gear set, you can create infinite gear ratios. That is the genius of eCVT! It’s one of the most brilliant transmission designs ever developed, without the pulleys and belts of a traditional CVT (that a lot of people, especially enthusiasts, tend to hate). The system is unbelievably simple. No belts, no pulleys. Just a single planetary gear set. And it is far less complicated than a traditional automatic transmission, DCT, or even a manual transmission. The catch, is that it must be paired with two electric motors. But it solves a very interesting problem. Typical transmissions have set gear ratios. This forces your engine to operate across a wide RPM range. videos.content: Nissan and Italdesign have created a new prototype vehicle – the Nissan GT-R50 by Italdesign – in their first-ever collaboration. Based on a production 2018 Nissan GT-R NISMO model, the unique car commemorates the 50th anniversaries of both the GT-R and Italdesign and will make its debut in Europe next month. “How often do you get to ask, ‘What if we created a GT-R without limits,’ and then actually get to build it?” said Alfonso Albaisa, Nissan’s senior vice president for global design. “This is a rare window in time when two big moments intersect: 50 years of Italdesign shaping the automotive world and 50 years of Nissan generating excitement through our iconic GT-R. So to celebrate this convergence, Nissan and Italdesign created this custom GT-R to mark 50 years of engineering leadership.” Italdesign developed, engineered and built the car. videos.content: What does it take to rejuvenate a poorly serviced and neglected car? In this episode of project Rottweil, we focus on the engine and getting this old M54 engine in perfect running order. We replace the rod bearings, disassemble and clean the oil pump, secure the oil pump nut, replace the oil pan gasket, replace catalytic converters, power steering & coolant lines, water pump, thermostat, radiator, fan clutch, alternator, intake manifold gaskets, fuel injectors, fuel filter, CCV, front sway bar, propshaft flex joint (guibo), center shaft bearing (CSB), transmission and engine mounts, belts & pulleys, service the DISA valve, etc... in short, we get a lot of work done.

videos.content: What happens when reproduction parts aren’t good enough and nostalgia meets aerospace-level engineering? In this episode of Capturing Car Culture, Larry Chen dives inside ICON, a California-based automotive company redefining what “restomod” really means. ICON takes iconic, rusting classics, preserves the original body, and mounts it onto a fully modern chassis, transforming vintage vehicles into reliable, daily-drivable machines. But this isn’t about bolt-on fixes. ICON goes above and beyond, using aerospace, marine, and military-grade components to solve a problem few talk about: modern reproduction parts simply don’t hold up. Known for their legendary 4x4 builds, ICON has quietly evolved. Today, they’ll build anything: trucks, coupes, sedans, and even wagons... tags: how to clean the mass airflow sensor
how to get better fuel economy
videos.content: How to clean a Mass Airflow Sensor. Mass Airflow Sensor cleaning can increase fuel economy, stop hesitation and stalling, and shut off your check engine light. This is a simple procedure and in this video I go in-depth about cleaning the sensor and I take readings from an OBDII scanner to show before and after cleaning the sensor. A mass airflow sensor gets dirty because of oiled filters such as a KNN air filter, air filters that are not replaced often enough, and dusty roads (salt, sand, pollen, etc). Symptoms of a dirty MAF sensor are hesitation, poor idle, bad fuel economy, and stalling. You can also get a check engine light with codes P0100, P0102, P0103, P0104, and P0105. videos.title: בעומק הרי סיירה מסתתרות עיירות רפאים נשכחות
videos.content: There’s something special about discovering places most people have forgotten. In this episode, Luna and I head deep into California’s Eastern Sierra backcountry to explore a string of old mining camps and ghost towns — a rugged 150-mile route filled with history, challenge, and incredible scenery. The journey begins just north of Bridgeport and winds through the remnants of the state’s gold-rush era — sites like Success Mine, Chemung Mine, Serita Mine, Masonic Camp, Pittsburg Mine, Belfort, Mt. Patterson Peak, Stone Cabin, and Pine Grove Ghost Town. Along the way, we climb above 11,000 feet, crawl over rocky trails, and take in some of the most stunning views anywhere in California. This is the kind of trip that reminds me why I love off-road adventure — exploring remote places, uncovering forgotten stories, and spending quiet nights under the stars. ************************************

videos.content: The 2023 Audi RS3 ($58,900 starting in the US) is now forbidden fruit for us here in Canada, since it is no longer sold within our borders. In today’s market it’s worth around £16,000. Next we have the Mk1 Vauxhall Astra GTE. It has a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder that produces 117hp and 150nm of torque. That power goes to the front wheels via a 5-speed manual gearbox and it weighs in at 925kg. Being a rare car it’s worth around £25,000 in today's market. Moving on we have the Mk2 VW Golf GTI 16v. videos.content: HOW TO TELL IF CAR BURNS ENGINE OIL FROM VALVE STEM SEALS OR PISTON RINGS In this video we will explain how to find out if a car burn oil from piston rings or from valve stem seals. The two most common causes for excessive oil consumption are worn piston rings or bad worn valve stem seals. The valve stem seals will let oil drip in the cylinder and your car will burn engine oil, while the piston rings will not collect all the oil from the cylinder wall and that will lead to excessive oil consumption and burning oil. We will explain how we usually find out whether your car is burning oil because of bad piston rings or from bad valve stem seals. It is a simple method that should guide you in the right direction to figure out if you need new piston rings or valve stem seals. videos.content: How hydrogen combustion engines work, versus gasoline engines. Hydrogen combustion engines can be more efficient and with better emissions versus gas engines, due to the fuel differences of H2. This video will look at eight major differences between gasoline and hydrogen fuels used in internal combustion engines. This includes the combustion reaction and byproducts, air fuel ratio, ignition energy, flame velocity, auto-ignition temperature, diffusivity, quenching distance, and density. These properties result in drastic differences between using the two fuels, though both can easily be adopted and used in traditional otto-cycle piston cylinder engines, often with little modification to the existing engine hardware. videos.title: לא מצליחים לנקז בלמים עם משאבת וואקום ידנית? זה מה שאתם צריכים לעשות- חלק א'
videos.content: *** קישורים בהמשך *** אם אתם לא מצליחים לנקז את הבלמים באמצעות משאבת הוואקום, זה לא כי המשאבה דפוקה, היא גם צריכה קצת אהבה. בסרטון הזה אני מסכם את הפעולות שצריך לעשות על מנת לגרום למשאבה לעבוד כמו שצריך ולבנות וואקום ללא מאמץ מיותר. משאבת הוואקום מהסרטון: כלי לסגירת הניפל: ראש לניקוז ייעיל יותר ממה שמגיע עם המשאבה: *** אזהרה*** מערכת הבלימה היא מערכת בטיחות! אין להתעסק במערכת הבלימה ללא ההכשרה וההסמכה המתאימים לכך. כל המוצג בסרטון הנו למטרת העשרה בלבד. אין באמור המלצה לביצוע מי מהפעולות המוצגות בסרטון. כל ניסיון לבצע את המוצג בסרטון נעשה על אחריות המבצע בלבד, ואין הערוץ או המציג אחראים לכל נזק, בין אם ישיר או עקיף, שייגרם כתוצאה מניסיון לחזור על הפעולות המוצגות בסרטון. צפיה בסרטון מהווה הסכמה ישירה לוויתור זה.

videos.content: The Rubicon Trail is the most famous 22-mile off-road trail in the world, and over the years the 4x4s that have attempted it have only gotten better. But it wasn’t started with 4x4s on 40-inch tires and big engines. Rather, it was started with little Jeeps on tiny tires and no lockers. So on this episode of Dirt Every Day presented by Tire Rack, Fred Williams and Dave Chappelle see just how far they can get on the ’Con with almost stock 4x4s. Equipped with just a winch and a sense of adventure, the guys hit the trail in 45- year-old 4x4s to see if they could make it across the world-renowned Rubicon Trail. #DirtEveryDay #4x4 #RubiconTrail

videos.title: זיוף קילומטראז ברכב.
videos.content: כאשר אתם מעוניינים לרכוש רכב משומש, משמעות המרחק שצבר מאז עלייתו על הכביש חשובה ביותר. הן מבחינה מכאנית, וכמובן מבחינה פיננסית. מחירון הרכב של לוי יצחק קובע למשל, כי ערכו של רכב שגמא מרחק כפול ויותר מהממוצע, נמוך ב-10% ממחיר רכב דומה שנסע פחות. אגב, זה עובד גם הפוך. מאחר שמדובר בפערים שיכולים להגיע לאלפי שקלים, יש תמריץ לא קטן לנוכלים לזייף את המרחק הנצבר לטובת כיסם הפרטי. גם העובדה שזיוף כזה הוא עבירה על החוק, לא ממש מרתיעה כאשר מנגד יש רווח מיידי. ואסור לשכוח - למרבה הצער, ממש לא קל לאתר זיופים כאלה.

videos.content: Brito and Dustin just got the opportunity of a lifetime: spending the day with Steve McQueen’s personal 1942 Chevrolet pickup. Watch as the guys see if they can get this legendary truck running and back on the road. Will it start after two decades of sitting, and will they discover what Steve saw in this classic pickup? videos.title: הסיבה הנפוצה ביותר להדלקת נורית כרית האוויר
tags: why is the air bag light on
videos.content: MOST COMMON REASON AIRBAG LIGHT IS ON We will explain what is the most common reason for the airbag light to be on on your car. We based this on our observation and 7/10 of ten cars that had the airbag light on was due to bad occupant sensor, known as occupancy mat, or seat occupancy sensor. If the occupancy sensor goes bad your airbag will be on because the airbag system will not be able to detect if the person sitting in the passenger seat is heavy enough for the passenger airbag to turned on or off. The seat occupancy sensor mat is integrated in the passenger seat and it will often require disassembly in order to replace the seat occupancy sensor. If your airbag light is on by scanning your airbag module you will be able to figure out what caused your airbag light to be on. tags: huracan sto vs maserati gt2 stradale
videos.content: We’re drag racing a Maserati GT2 Stradale against a Lamborghini Huracan STO over the 1/4-mile and 1/2-mile. They’ll also compete in a 100mph brake test. It’s time for two track-focused supercars to go head-to-head! We’ve got Mat in the Maserati GT2 Stradale, and he’s lining up against a Lamborghini Huracan STO! The two are fairly evenly matched, but which will come out on top over the quarter-mile? Let’s take a closer look at the contenders… The Maserati is powered by a 3-litre twin-turbo V6, and this produces 640hp and 720Nm. This power is sent to the rear wheels only via a dual-clutch gearbox, and it weighs in at 1,475kg. Then we come to the Lambo. It’s equipped with a 5.2-litre naturally-aspirated V10, and this produces 640hp and 565Nm. It also has a dual-clutch gearbox sending power to the rear wheels only, but it’s slightly lighter than the Maserati, tipping the scales at 1,436kg. S

videos.content: Mercedes-Benz has started large-scale production of its new electric axial-flux motor at the Berlin-Marienfelde plant in Germany. This video shows the oddly satisfying production process of the high-performance axial-flux electric motor that will be used in future Mercedes-AMG electric vehicles. The new motor technology is compact, lightweight and designed for high power density, making it an important part of Mercedes-AMG’s next generation of electric performance cars. The axial-flux motor will make its debut in the Mercedes-AMG GT 4-Door Coupé. At the Berlin-Marienfelde plant, Mercedes-Benz uses highly precise production processes, automated handling, laser technology, intelligent control systems and quality-control steps to build this advanced electric drive system. videos.title: מצלמת GoPro בתוך צמיג רכב בזמן נסיעה
videos.content: I mount a GoPro camera inside of a car tire and drive the car around to see what it looks like inside of a wheel when we drive around every day. I remove the tire from the rim then I mount the GoPro to the inside of the wheel and mount the tire back on the rim, mount the tire back on and re-install the wheel on the car. Then I drive around and take a look at what it looks like the inside of the tire to see inside what the tire is going through as I drive through a bumpy road a smooth road and take turns at a higher speed. it was a really interesting an awesome perspective to see what the tire is going through as we're driving our car. and at the end of this video, I deflate the tire and the air pressure inside the tire does something really cool so you have to watch to the end. videos.title: כיצד לזהות מצמד מחליק באמצעות בדיקה פשוטה
videos.content: This is an easy way to tell if your car has a slipping clutch! It is a very simple test that you can do. Get the car revving low (between 2k and 3k RPMs), and floor the throttle of the car. If your RPMs jump up and your speed doesn't jump up as fast, your car's clutch is definitely slipping, and you will probably need a new clutch soon. videos.title: מרצדס־בנץ G63 AMG 6x6 מול G63 AMG מודל 2014 — ראש בראש, פרק 46
videos.content: On this episode of Head 2 Head, Jonny Lieberman heads to Graz, Austria, the home of one of the world's toughest off roaders - the Mercedes-Benz G-Wagen. The last time a G63 appeared on Head 2 Head, it beat out the all-new and quite excellent Range Rover Supercharged. This time, however, the G63 faces even stiffer competition — another G63. Of course, this particular G has an extra axle, because it's the $500,000+ G63 AMG 6x6! Costing roughly twice as much as the awesome twin-turbo V-12 powered G65, the 6x6 is the ultimate expression of the Gelandewagen... on paper. But is it actually any good? Is the 6x6 as awesome as it looks, or is the regular G-Wagen just too well thought out? And why is the 6-wheeled truck always jumping in the air like that? Watch and find out!

videos.title: בדיקה מהירה של מזרקי דלק
tags: what is fuel injector resistance supposed to be
videos.content: How to test fuel injectors for pulsing. Learn how to check fuel injectors. I use a screwdriver to test fuel injectors to make sure they are firing. You place a long screwdriver to the base of each injector and put your ear to the end of the screwdriver (like a doctors stethoscope). You should hear constant clicking. If not, then your injector isn't firing or is firing intermittently. Symptoms of bad injectors are a check engine light with codes P0300 through P0308, misfiring, hesitation, poor fuel economy, stalling, and a poor idle. **If the video was helpful, remember to give it a "thumbs up" and consider subscribing. videos.title: מה מסתתר בתוך מנוע טויוטה שעבר 500 אלף ק״מ?
videos.content: Ever wonder what's inside an engine with over 300,000 km? In this video we teardown a Toyota Prius 1NZ-FXE 4 cylinder engine from a 2004 Toyota Prius. The engine features drive by wire throttle body, cast aluminum intake manifold, aluminum head and block, dual over head cams with variable valve timing on the intake, an accessory belt for the water pump only, and a timing chain powering the two camshafts. The Prius engine is the detuned version of the 1NZ that makes less power but is more efficient because it runs on the Atkinson cycle. After removing the oil pan, timing cover and valve cover it is evident that after 17 years and 300,000+ miles the engine is tarnished dark on the inside. The oil control rings are clogged, and carbon buildup is evident on the piston heads. The bottom of the sludge and oil pickup is lined with sludge. The intake system has carbon buildup from the PCV system

Junior Cars lent us all four cars, and they’re miniature replicas of these world-famous sports cars! Each of the four cars comes with a steel chassis and fibreglass bodywork that replicates the original car. All four cars here are equipped with a 125cc single-cylinder engine that produces a total of 9hp, and all cars have a 3-speed sequential gearbox. All four cars are also Rear Wheel Drive only. So how will this one play out? The Ferrari, Jag and Mercedes have front-mounted engines, while the Porsche is rear-mounted - will that prove decisive? There’s only one way to find out for sure… LET’S RACE!

videos.title: מה שברתי במסלול Rubicon
videos.content: Recon One just came home from the Rubicon and not everything survived the trip. It's been 11 months since I brought this 2021 Wrangler Willys home for this build series, and last week it faced its biggest test yet. In this update, we go over the damage: a shredded fender liner, a fender and light that lost an argument with a tree, and a bent steering stabilizer I didn't discover until I was white knuckling it down the freeway. We'll also cover the upgrades that went on right before the trip, the AEV tire carrier, PSC heavy duty steering pump, sPOD, and a full set of KC HiLiTES, plus a first look at what's coming next. The Rubicon isn't the hardest trail this Jeep is going to see, so the next phase starts now: 40-inch tires, new axles, and a lift kit that isn't even on the market yet. videos.title: הסרט התיעודי של Hagerty על Porsche 911 Turbo, עם ג׳ייסון קמיסה, הנרי קצ׳פול ואורחים
videos.content: Mobil 1 presents: 50 Years of Turbo, the Porsche 911 Turbo documentary. For half a century, the word "Turbo," has been synonymous with the fastest 911 products coming out of Stuttgart, Germany. From the original 930 Turbo that was affectionately referred to as "The Widowmaker," for how the early turbocharged power delivery would arrive mid-corner, to the iconic 964 Turbo driven by detective Mike Lowrey in the original "Bad Boys," film, to the all-weather capable, continent crushing all-new 992.2 Turbo, these are the 911s that have adorned bedroom walls for the last 50 years and seem poised to continue for the next 50. Join hosts Jason Cammisa, Henry Catchpole, Jeff Zwart, Pat Long, Loni Unser and Lars Kern as they take you through every generation (plus some GT2 variants on the Turbo nameplate) of the 911 Turbo. Brought to you ad-free by Mobil 1. #PorscheTurbo #50YearsOfTurbo #Porsche911

videos.content: The full video series in one video! Join us on a thrilling 2-week overland adventure to the Arctic Ocean! We explore Canada’s breathtaking wilderness, tackle remote backcountry trails, camp at stunning sites, encounter incredible wildlife, and face countless challenges that push us to the limit. Accompanied by Shawn from "The Story Till Now," this journey is packed with excitement, unexpected obstacles, and unforgettable moments. Along the way we explore remote areas of British Columbia, the Yukon and Northwest Territories. We'll travel along the Steward Cassier Highway, the Dempster Highway and many back road trails just to see where they go. We'll visit many small towns and historical sites along our Journey like Dawson City, Watson Lake, Inuvik Tuktoyuktuk and more. This Arctic expedition is more than a road trip—it’s a life-changing experience. #arcticexpedition #overlanding #camping

videos.title: מדוע אירופה חוששת מהמכוניות הסיניות? סקירת Chery Tiggo 4
videos.content: This is our in-depth review of the all-new Chery TIGGO 4. We’re reviewing the interior design, space and practicality, finding out what it’s like to drive, and reviewing how it performs in a 0-60mph & brake test. This is the all-new Chery Tiggo 4! Mat’s got his hands on this affordable family car to see if this latest offering from China has enough to sway you away from more established competitors like the Renault Captur and Volkswagen T-Roc. So let’s get into it, starting with the design. On first glance, it’s easy to see that the Tiggo 4 designers have taken inspiration from several other cars. The front end looks reminiscent of a DS7, the rear and side profile look similar to a T-Roc, and the back end looks like a VW Tiguan! Ultimately though, it still looks smart. The large grille helps it stand out, and around the back there are cool-looking taillights and a full-length light bar.

videos.title: Silverado EV WT vs LT vs RST vs Denali — איזו טנדר חשמלי הכי מתאים לך? -השוואה בין הדגמים- סופר ג׳יפ
videos.content: שואלים מה ההבדל בין דגמים של הטנדים שלנו - החטיבה החשמלית אז בואו נעשה סדר ונסביר: WT = Work Truck: מכוון לעבודה, כושר העמסה הגבוה ביותר (כמעט 900 ק״ג), טווח לפי גרסה: 3WT עושה 630 ק״מ, 4WT עושה 720 ק״מ, 5WT עושה 670 ק״מ, וה־8WT מוביל עם 790 ק״מ. LT / RST / Denali = דגמי מנהלים: אותו בסיס חשמלי מתוחכם, 750 כ״ס, 740 ק״מ טווח, היגוי כפול, מתלי אוויר, תקרה שקופה, וגרירה של 3.5 טון. RST נותן מראה ספורטיבי, Denali נוצה של יוקרה בגזרת Cadillac Escalade, ו־LT באמצע עם נוחות מעודנת (כולל גרסה עם ג׳אנטים 18" וטווח קצת קצר יותר של 656 ק״מ). יש גם את היכולת לקפל את הגב בין הארגז לקבינה (pass-through) כשהצורך בעומק אחסון ארוך קיים. אין פחות טוב או יותר טוב — כל אחד בוחר לפי מה שמשרת אותו רוצים להרגיש בעצמכם? קבעו נסיעת מבחן, ✆ *6855 אנחנו נגיע אליכם או שתבואו לסניפים: חיפה, חדרה, רחובות (ראשי), אשדוד, באר-שבע. הקפה על האש :) סופר ג׳יפ - אל תחלום, תגשים!
